verdict.rationale: Pipecat is a voice-agent framework with a hosted cloud, and such a platform could plausibly offer scheduled or recurring jobs, so the axis applies. The evidence covers pipelines, Flows, the development runner, evals, telephony webhooks and the Cloud REST API for sessions and agents. None of it documents a scheduler, cron, or any recurring-job capability. Starting sessions on demand via the API is a one-off action, not a recurring schedule.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
